description: Ask a seller's Sales Agent a question, from anywhere on the network, without leaving this connector. It answers in the seller's voice using their locked-in memories (events, promotions, policies, stock). Pass the seller_mcp_url from a discovery result and an optional contact so the seller can reach back.

contact.description: Optional reach-back identifier (email, handle, or the buyer agent MCP url).

seller_mcp_url.description: mcp_ref.seller_mcp_url from a find_seller / get_seller_products result.

name: ask_sales_agent
